report.scope: Build local/server.py per docs/backlog/specs/pbi-005-local-server.md revision 2 (spec gate passed): the read-only local server serving the page, the /api/snapshot data snapshot and the /api/events live stream on 127.0.0.1, with the Host/Origin gate, the network-path guard, and board_config.local() gaining local.port. Grounding path: ran-suite (all three configured suites run in the worktree via python and node).
report.summary: 5 files created/modified in local/server*, local/tests/**, board.config.json and exporters/board_config.py. 53 tests added (4 in test_config_local.py, 36 in test_server.py, 13 in test_server_live.py). Suite counts: python -m unittest discover -s tests = 307 passed/0 failed (unchanged baseline); node tests/page.test.mjs = 96 checks passed (unchanged); python -m unittest discover -s local/tests = 247 passed/0 failed (194 baseline + 53 new), re-run 3x clean. Nothing committed, staged, pushed or deployed.

changes.why: The local server: the config read, the network-path guard, the read-only opener (open_read, never db.open_db), the snapshot state (State), the live-push hub (Hub), the request handler (the Host/Origin gate, the page wrapper, the three routes, the one-line plain-text refusal shape) and the command line (serve/main), per the approved spec.

local(cfg) gains 'port', defaulting to 8765 and validated as a whole number from 1 to 65535 (a bool refused, since True is an int in Python); databasePath's existing behaviour and messages are unchanged.
The 'local' block gains "port": 8765, the default the parent spec anticipated for the second local-first PBI to land.

Extended for local.port per the spec's own instruction (the file is PBI-019's, in an allowed area): default, a given value, and every invalid form (string, float, bool, 0, 70000). Existing assertions were updated to expect 'port' in local()'s return, since local() now returns both keys; no assertion was weakened, only widened to the new, intentionally changed contract.

Shared test fixtures: minimal conforming documents per record kind, a temporary-database/page Env, and an HTTP client with explicit control over Host/Origin/raw bytes, needed to drive the gate and the stream without a browser.

Binding, the request gate (six do_ methods, framework-raised refusals, Host/Origin), the page wrapper, snapshot conformance (AC-69 non-vacuous), never-writes, not-ready/error responses, the network-path guard (AC-67) and the command line, per spec section 9.

Live push (AC-68), reconnection/reset semantics (AC-SV9), the no-poll-with-no-clients and no-client-can-stall-another cases (AC-SV10), the stream cap, and running beside a real collector.run_pass (AC-SV11).

tests.covers: board_config.local()'s new port key: default, override, and every invalid form

binding, the Host/Origin gate, the six do_ methods and framework refusals (400/414/431/501/505), the page wrapper, snapshot conformance and the corrupt-row fallback, never-writes, not-ready/error responses, the network-path guard, the command line

a change delivered to an open stream, a deletion, retry/reset/no-reset-loop/larger-of-since-and-last-event-id, the heartbeat and disconnect drop, no-poll-with-no-clients, no client stalling another, the 9th-stream cap, and a real collector.run_pass running beside an open stream and an in-flight snapshot
the exporters and the page's derivation, unaffected by this PBI; 307 tests, unchanged from baseline
the published page's inline script; unaffected by this PBI; 96 checks, unchanged from baseline
records/schema/db/collector conformance, unaffected except test_config_local.py's extension; 247 tests total (194 baseline + 53 new)

acceptance.criterion: AC-67: a UNC local.databasePath refuses to start, exit 2, the path printed exactly as configured, no socket bound, nothing created

AC-68: a database change while a client is connected to /api/events delivers a change event naming the record's path and new document within three poll intervals (server-level leg; the in-browser leg is PBI-007's demonstration)
AC-69: /api/snapshot returns an entry for every stored conforming record with skipped 0 (non-vacuous), a bad row is omitted and counted in skipped without costing the rest of its kind
AC-SV1: 127.0.0.1-only binding, AF_INET, allow_reuse_address false, a LAN connection refused
AC-SV2: Host allow-list, every refusal shares the one-line text/plain shape with no echo
AC-SV3: the six do_ methods funnel through the gate; PATCH gives 501 before it; no Access-Control-Allow-* header anywhere
AC-SV4: board_config.local(cfg) gains port, defaulting to 8765, validated 1..65535 whole numbers only; --port 0 binds a free port
acceptance.evidence: local/tests/test_config_local.py port tests and test_server.py CommandLine.test_port_0_binds_a_free_port

acceptance.criterion: AC-SV5: GET / returns the wrapped, well-formed page with the hoisted title and the local marker; HEAD mirrors it with no body; 404/500 as specified; site/** untouched

AC-SV6: the server never writes the database's content (query_only=1; file bytes/mtime/data_version/sqlite_master unchanged even with db.open_db/schema.create_schema/db.upsert/db.delete patched to raise)
AC-SV7: no response holds collector_* state or an answers table's contents; the API routes hold no 'answers' substring; snapshot kinds are a subset of records.TABLES

AC-SV8: with no database file the page still serves and /api/snapshot is 503 with Retry-After and no file created; a too-new schema names both versions; records serve once the collector creates the database, with no restart
AC-SV9: the stream's headers/retry line; ?since= vs Last-Event-ID reset semantics, the larger value wins either way, no reset loop; the heartbeat; the 9th stream is 503
AC-SV10: no polling while no client is connected, resuming on the next connection, within the stated tolerance; a client that stops reading is dropped and cannot stall another
AC-SV11: the server and a real collector.run_pass run against the same file without blocking each other; a snapshot still answers under a held BEGIN IMMEDIATE

AC-SV12: main([]) starts, prints the URL and database, returns 0 when stopped; exit 2 for every named start-up refusal naming its cause, 1 otherwise; a raising handler gives 500 with a stderr-only traceback and no Python-naming Server header
acceptance.evidence: test_server.py CommandLine class and Errors class

follow_ups.note: GO/NO-GO quality gate on local/server.py and its tests. The close-out expectation's suite-green half is met (see report.summary); its code-review half is this hand-off.

AC-66 (netstat inspection), AC-70 to AC-73, AC-68's in-browser demonstration leg, Task Scheduler start-at-log-on and stdout/stderr log capture: all named out of this PBI's scope by the spec's section 12.
